allow: Bash(echo "=== iscsi: 日志内容分类（排除 WARNING 后）==="; grep "iscsi:" /tmp/iscsi_log.txt | grep -v "taskQueue op off workloop" | sed -E 's/^[0-9-]+ [0-9:.]+[+-][0-9]+ [0-9a-fx]+ +[A-Za-z]+ +[0-9a-fx]+ +[0-9]+ +[0-9]+ +[^ ]+ +//' | sed -E 's/\\\(sid: [0-9]+, cid: [0-9]+\\\)/\(sid,cid\)/g; s/task %#x/task/g; s/[0-9]+//g' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -30)

Bash(echo "=== 1. 真正的 panic 检查（精确）==="; grep -iE "panic|crashed|trap|machine check" /tmp/iscsi_log.txt | grep -iv "RBAssertion\\|frontboard" | head -5 || echo "无 panic"; echo; echo "=== 2. taskQueue 警告来源定位 ==="; grep "taskQueue op off workloop" /tmp/iscsi_log.txt | head -1 | sed -E 's/^\([0-9-]+ [0-9:.]+\).*/\\1/'; echo "警告是否与 queueTask 同线程（看时间戳是否与 Queued task 交织）:"; echo; echo "=== 3. Bytes per second 负值样本 ==="; grep "Bytes per second: -" /tmp/iscsi_log.txt | head -3; echo; echo "=== 4. DEBUG kext 运行时间证据（DBLog 出现时间范围）==="; grep "Sent PDU type" /tmp/iscsi_log.txt | head -1 | grep -oE "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:.]+"; grep "Sent PDU type" /tmp/iscsi_log.txt | tail -1 | grep -oE "^[0-9-]+ [0-9:.]+")
